title: Version 3.0.0 Changelog
items: Rebuild the design foundation
Add a themed pointer set
Add a spring and gesture motion layer
Rework Modal, Toast and Tooltip
Rework the app shell
Rework the file manager surfaces
Rework the dashboard and auth screens
Move settings, upload and viewer onto the new palette
Split the semantic colours into fill and text roles
Enforce the theming conventions with lint rules
Warm the neutral ramp and lift the dark theme off black
Add backend, frontend, and electron CI test suites tests
Auto focus on 'Name' input box on signup form
Validate the auth forms before they reach the server
Paint the desktop splash and error screen as the app theme
Refuse a bad upload before it is already sent
Show refused uploads in a dialog box with info
Stage a dropped folder once, not once per effect run
Keep the client's mtime on upload
Memoise the auth and theme context values
Stop a toast resetting the form behind it
Fix the stuttering when a modal closes
Record when files and folders were last opened
Report the server's read time on the Cloud Drive
Serve the dashboard's recent files from accessed_at
List a folder only once per view change
Remove duplicate logic from backend and frontend
Run production builds on a newer Node release
Bump CI/CD action tag versions
Update backend, frontend and electron dependencies
Use redis:8-alpine docker image
Replace unmaintained MFA, CLS deps and harden MFA
Fix failover DB name on docker compose
Switch to .NET 10 SDK for building TmaCloudFs
Secure Cloud Drive host and fix staging/buffer leaks
Fix ONLYOFFICE schemeless server URL crash
Sync ONLYOFFICE editor theme with the app toggle
